{npc:Muriel}, of the Thais sorcerer guild, is researching a new spell against the undead and needs a defiled bone. Take his container to the Cursed Bone Pit, in the underground north of Thais, dig until you find a well-preserved human skeleton and bring him the sample to receive a {item:Death Ring}.
Muriel is researching a spell against the undead.
to dig in the Bone Pit
recommended, always useful for climbing back up in caves
If you lose the {item:Ectoplasm Container}, you can buy another from {wiki:The Explorer Society} in Northport or Port Hope.
On the way you may come across a {creature:Cyclops} lured by other players: be careful if you are a low level.
Go to the sorcerer guild in **Thais** and talk to {npc:Muriel}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you an {item:Ectoplasm Container}.
The Cursed Bone Pit is in the underground of the {wiki:Ancient Temple}. Leave **Thais** through the **north** gate: the temple is just **northwest** of that gate. Enter and go down the temple steps.

Follow the map to the Cursed Bone Pit, underground **north of Thais** (the {wiki:Ancient Temple} area). On the way there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}.
Route to the Cursed Bone Pit
Dig until you find a human
In the Bone Pit, clear the floor of corpses and use the {item:Shovel|shovel} to dig until you find a humanoid skeleton.
Use the {item:Ectoplasm Container} on the human skeleton. You receive an {item:Ectoplasm Container (Bone)}.

Go back the same way: follow the route on the map in reverse to the steps of the {wiki:Ancient Temple} and go up to the surface. You come out northwest of the north gate of **Thais**; enter the city and go to the sorcerers' guild.
Go back to {npc:Muriel} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}.
**Do not** try to give him a second sample to get another Death Ring: he keeps it and gives you nothing in return.
The quest shows up in the Quest Log under *Tibia Tales*.
